# ledgerly

Billing core for the Ledgerly invoicing product: customers, invoices, payments and the
outstanding-balance ledger, exposed through a small HTTP layer.

No dependencies beyond Node 18+.

```
npm test        # the unit suite (test/*.unit.js)
npm run lint    # house rules (see scripts/lint.js)
npm start       # HTTP server on :8080
```

More in `docs/`.
